Your academic data (profile, quizzes, per-question answers, class statistics, aggregated AI insights, local biometrics, and private messages) is protected by active anti-spying safeguards, disabled cloud/ADB backups, and reserved exclusively for SVT learning.

Last updated: 2026 (v3)

1. Application Controller
BioTerre SVT is an educational application created in 2026 by Ayman BIROUK (contact: biroukayman@gmail.com).

2. Data Collected & Educational Purpose
The app processes only data strictly necessary for classroom management and academic tracking:
• Account & identity: full name (teachers view the official name from the imported class PDF/Massar roster to preserve grading accuracy even if a display name changes), role (student or teacher), Massar ID, recovery email ("massarnumber@taalim.ma" or entered email), professional email (teacher), school/institution, optional phone and birth date.
• Academic activity & statistics: class enrollment, quiz scores, overall per-student and class-wide question success/failure counts, per-question right/wrong answer review, video completion, document opening status, private teacher-student messages, badges, and prioritized or date-sorted notifications.
• AI Class Analysis & SVT Lab: when a teacher triggers "AI Analysis" or uses the SVT Lab dictionary/generator via Firebase AI Logic, only anonymized aggregated class statistics or SVT scientific terms are sent — never student emails, passwords, or private messages.
• Offline storage & automatic cleanup: downloaded lessons, pending sync logs, exported PDFs, and temporary uploads are isolated locally and purged automatically upon sign-out.

3. Fingerprint Biometrics & Local Lock
• Optional fingerprint sign-in and unlock: handled solely by Android's system BiometricPrompt with local AES-256-GCM encryption backed by AndroidKeyStore. No biometric templates or images ever leave your device or reach our servers.
• Secondary PIN lock: hashed locally using PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 (100,000 iterations, random salt) with temporary brute-force lockout.

4. Anti-Spying Controls & Device Permissions
• Active anti-spying protection: blocks screenshots, screen-recording spyware, and Recent Apps previews (FLAG_SECURE) across screens and sensitive dialogs; disables Android cloud/ADB backups for credentials and offline files; marks sensitive clipboard copies (EXTRA_IS_SENSITIVE); enforces HTTPS-only downloads with redirect checks and bounded archive parsing.
• Camera: used solely to scan class QR Codes. No personal photos or videos are recorded.
• System Photo Picker (zero broad storage permissions): manual per-item selection without broad storage access.
• Notifications & background sync: priority real-time alerts and periodic WorkManager checks.

5. App Integrity & Confidentiality
• Firebase App Check / reCAPTCHA Enterprise app attestation, single-phone student binding, strict per-class isolation, and administrator approval for teachers.
• Zero ads, zero tracking SDKs, and zero commercial data sharing.
• Running a modified, pirated, or tampered APK voids official security and confidentiality guarantees.

6. Retention & Rights
You can review your profile in the Profile tab (excluding locked roster/QR integrity fields). Contact: biroukayman@gmail.com.
Educational access rules, official PDF/Massar roster identity, educational AI guidelines, biometric/anti-spying safeguards, and strict anti-piracy protections.

Last updated: 2026 (v3)

1. Purpose & Acceptance
These Terms of Use govern access to and use of BioTerre SVT (created in 2026 by Ayman BIROUK). Installing or using the app constitutes full acceptance of these terms.

2. Accounts, Official PDF/Massar Roster & QR Lock
• Teachers: submit accurate profile details (including school name) and await administrator approval before managing classes, official PDF/Massar rosters, quizzes, detailed question analytics, and AI class summaries.
• Students: join classes via Massar ID or QR Code (default recovery email "massarnumber@taalim.ma").
• Academic integrity: to prevent impersonation or grading confusion, teachers always see the student's official PDF/Massar roster name in class records and statistics even if the student alters their account display name.
• Guest Mode: read-only demonstration preview.

3. Educational Use, AI & Conduct
• BioTerre SVT is reserved solely for Life & Earth Sciences (SVT) teaching and study.
• Summaries generated by "AI Analysis" and SVT Lab definitions are educational aids intended for teacher review.
• Posting unlawful, defamatory, fraudulent content, or insecure links is strictly prohibited.

4. Anti-Spying, Anti-Piracy & Intellectual Property
• All intellectual property rights in BioTerre SVT belong exclusively to Ayman BIROUK (2026).
• Users are STRICTLY PROHIBITED from: bypassing screen-capture protections (FLAG_SECURE); spying on, intercepting, or harvesting other users' data; decompiling, disassembling, reverse-engineering, or repackaging the APK; distributing pirated clones; or circumventing App Check, biometrics, PBKDF2 PIN lock, single-device binding, or Firestore security rules.
• Any tampering, score manipulation, spying, or piracy results in immediate account termination and exposes offenders to legal and disciplinary action.

5. Limitation of Liability & Publisher Protection
• The creator and publisher (Ayman BIROUK) provides the application "as is" for educational purposes and shall NOT be liable for: (a) unlawful, fraudulent, or improper misuse by any user; (b) external HTTPS links or files uploaded by users; (c) damages arising from unofficial/tampered APKs, rooted devices, or network/Google Play Services outages.
• Each user remains solely responsible for securing their device, enrolled fingerprints, password, and PIN code.

6. Official Contact
Report security issues, piracy, or legal inquiries to: biroukayman@gmail.com.
